description: This file defines various testing tools related to expectations in a Playwright testing environment, including visibility, text, value, list, URL, and title expectations.

methods.name: expectVisible
methods.description: Defines a tool to check if an element with a specific role and accessible name is visible on the page.

methods.name: expectVisibleText
methods.description: Defines a tool to check if specific text is visible on the page.

methods.name: expectValue
methods.description: Defines a tool to check the value of a specific element, such as textbox, checkbox, radio, etc.

methods.name: expectList
methods.description: Defines a tool to verify that a list with a given ARIA role and accessible name contains specific items in order.

methods.name: expectURL
methods.description: Defines a tool to verify the current page URL matches a string or regex pattern.

methods.name: expectTitle
methods.description: Defines a tool to verify the page title matches an expected value.
